description: This file defines the TradeDao class, which provides CRUD operations and query methods for managing Trade entities in a local SQLite database within an Android application. It includes methods for inserting, updating, deleting, and retrieving trade records, as well as specialized queries like searching by symbol and fetching trade dates.

classes.name: TradeDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object (DAO) class responsible for handling CRUD operations for Trade entities in the local SQLite database.

methods.name: insertTrade
methods.description: Inserts a new Trade record into the database and returns the row ID.

methods.name: updateTrade
methods.description: Updates an existing Trade record identified by its id.

methods.name: deleteTrade
methods.description: Deletes a Trade record by its ID.

methods.name: getTradeById
methods.description: Retrieves a Trade by its ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: getAllTrades
methods.description: Fetches all trades ordered by entry date descending.

methods.name: getTradesByStatus
methods.description: Fetches trades filtered by their status.

methods.name: getTradesByDate
methods.description: Fetches trades for a specific entry date.

methods.name: searchTradesBySymbol
methods.description: Searches trades by symbol using a LIKE query.

methods.name: deleteAllTrades
methods.description: Deletes all trade records from the database.

methods.name: getTradeCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of trades in the database.

methods.name: getDistinctTradeDates
methods.description: Retrieves a list of distinct trade entry dates for calendar view.
